scope: development only; no inverse fitting or fresh evaluation
selection: same predeclared configuration must pass all four arms; retain every failure
checkpoint_rule: optimizer-returned final state; atomically retained before independent diagnostics or field scoring
data_policy: reuse exact saved v2 observations; load hidden reference field only after final checkpoint and raw training report

reference.hidden_field: 40x20 cell centers at every reference output

observations.pairing: exact same phase-B noise seed in every arm

supplemental_near_interface_audit.role: report only; no acceptance, fitting, or checkpoint selection

decision.start_policy: fresh matched log-off initialization in every case; probe checkpoint states are not reused
decision.selection_rule: persistent only if finite monotone trajectories, no worse on both cases within relative 1e-8, and worst terminal objective ratio improves by at least 1e-4; otherwise reset; reject followup if neither is finite monotone on both

training_grid.objective_weights: uniform mean over all interior rows; each bottom family retains its own uniform mean
